description: UK State Pension for people living outside the UK: which gap years can still be filled with voluntary National Insurance after the 6 April 2026 change, at Class 2 or Class 3, each year’s cost and 5 April deadline…

appliedBefore2026.description: Applied to pay for 2024–25 or 2025–26 on or before 5 April 2026

auAboveFreeArea.description: Australia only: income already above the Age Pension income-test free area (default true)

contributionYearsFor10.description: Years of UK-PAID contributions only, for the 10-year test from 2026–27 (no NI credits, no voluntary years abroad); defaults to ukContributionYears

gapYears.description: Tax years to fill, by start year (e.g. 2023 = 2023–24); 2020 to 2026

previousClass.description: If applied before 6 April 2026: the class being paid, 2 or 3 (Class 2 payers must also apply for 2026–27 Class 3 by 5 April 2027)

qualifyingYears.description: Qualifying years already on the UK National Insurance record

residence.description: Where the pension will be drawn: decides yearly increases and local deductions (NZ Super, Australian Age Pension income test, Canadian GIS)

ukContributionYears.description: Years of UK contributions paid in total

ukResidenceYears.description: Longest stretch living in the UK, years in a row

workedBeforeLeaving.description: Worked in the UK immediately before leaving
